pages.title: Saturday at the market
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: How was your weekend? Did you go anywhere?
lines.audioText: How was your weekend? Did you go anywhere?
lines.translation: Como foi seu fim de semana? Você foi a algum lugar?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes! I went to a market on Saturday and had coffee with a friend
lines.audioText: Yes! I went to a market on Saturday and had coffee with a friend.
lines.translation: Sim! Fui a uma feira no sábado e tomei café com uma amiga

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: That sounds nice. Did you buy anything?
lines.audioText: That sounds nice. Did you buy anything?
lines.translation: Parece legal. Você comprou alguma coisa?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Just some fruit. Then we took photos by the river
lines.audioText: Just some fruit. Then we took photos by the river.
lines.translation: Só algumas frutas. Depois tiramos fotos perto do rio

questions.prompt: Where did Ana go on Saturday?
Who did Ana have coffee with?
questions.answer: Ana had coffee with a friend

pages.title: A quiet Sunday
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: And what did you do on Sunday?
lines.audioText: And what did you do on Sunday?
lines.translation: E o que você fez no domingo?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I stayed at home. I was tired, so I watched a film
lines.audioText: I stayed at home. I was tired, so I watched a film.
lines.translation: Fiquei em casa. Estava cansada, então assisti a um filme

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Was it good? I’m looking for something to watch
lines.audioText: Was it good? I’m looking for something to watch.
lines.translation: Foi bom? Estou procurando algo para assistir

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: It was really funny! What about you? How was your weekend?
lines.audioText: It was really funny! What about you? How was your weekend?
lines.translation: Foi muito engraçado! E você? Como foi seu fim de semana?

questions.answer: Ana thought the film was really funny

pages.title: Tell a weekend story

items.prompt: What did you do last weekend?

items.cue: Give your opinion and add one detail

items.cue: Add who was there, then ask about my weekend
items.hint: I spent time with … Who did you see?

pages.title: Tell the action and say how it was
pages.instruction: Connect the meaning, the form and the example

rows.subject: Place or opinion in the past
rows.example: The market was busy. We were tired

rows.subject: A finished action
rows.example: I went to a market. Then I had coffee

rows.subject: Ask about the action
rows.example: Did you take photos? — Yes, I did

pages.title: Build your weekend story
pages.instruction: Choose a weekend and use three pictures to tell its story

pages.title: What Niamh actually did
pages.instruction: Listen to both voice notes, then answer and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! You asked about my Sunday. I didn’t visit the museum in the end. The weather was beautiful, so I went to the beach instead
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! You asked about my Sunday. I didn’t visit the museum in the end. The weather was beautiful, so I went to the beach instead.
pages.greeting: Here’s what I ended up doing on Sunday

items.prompt: Where did Niamh go instead of the museum?
Why did she change her plan?
items.answer: Niamh changed her plan because the weather was beautiful

items.prompt: What did she do after her walk?
items.answer: Niamh took photos and had lunch with a friend

additionalAudios.audioText: I walked for an hour and took some photos. Then I had lunch with a friend. It was a quiet afternoon, but I really enjoyed it. What did you do?
